title: Add success screen to NewProjectWizard
description: After all scaffolding steps complete, render a success screen showing the project name, template type used, and next-step instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: Success screen appears after scaffolding completes
Shows project name in the success message
Uses green color for the success indicator

steps.details: When all scaffold steps complete, set state to { progressStep: 'done' }. Render a success screen instead of the progress steps.

Render: <Box flexDirection='column' marginTop={1}><Text color='green' bold>✅ Project created successfully!</Text><Text>  Name: <Text bold>{projectName}</Text></Text><Text>  Type: <Text bold>{templateType}</Text></Text><Text marginTop={1}>Next steps:</Text><Text>  <Text color='cyan'>cd {projectName} && rocket loop</Text></Text></Box>

steps.description: Exit the Ink app after success screen is shown
steps.details: Import useApp from ink. In the success screen component, call app.exit() after a brief delay (500ms) or on any keypress to clean up the Ink render and return control to the terminal.

technicalNotes: useApp hook from ink provides app.exit() to properly terminate the Ink render
Call process.exit(0) after app.exit() if the CLI should exit completely
